kite.name: Kite River General
kite.line: We shall hold the middle ford and wait for enemy movements.

rhino.name: Rhino General's Watch
rhino.line: Hold the center, secure the middle crossing, and await orders.

orchid.name: Orchid's Steady Hand
orchid.line: Hold the banks, watch the paths. Patience is our shield.

tiger.name: Tiger General's Watch
tiger.line: We secure the west ford, seek a pact, and strike where needed.
